scope: Native real-mob AI melee/controlled API capability numeric facts; no production elbow adapter or client validation

collection.ground_subset_incomplete_reason: Its six original floating-actor air prototypes did not attack; only the eight observed ground/cancel/death cases are retained.

conclusions: Native callbacks and same-tick system.run do not expose buffered base knockback; next-tick observation is required in these samples.
Canceled native melee still emits entityHitEntity; this event alone is not accepted-hurt proof.
True airborne targets receive a native vertical base kick; the original Java air branch keeps its pre-knockback Y velocity.
Controlled API vertical0.2 yields about0.2 at resistance0 and0.5, changing rather than restoring the source air branch.
Full resistance leaves velocity unchanged in observed cases.
A fixed extra impulse/knockback or guessed resistance/attack attribute cannot establish source equivalence.
unimplemented: Exact native force operation order and general composition for arbitrary pre-existing velocity
Readable source attack attributes, enchantment hooks, Player attack charge and target resistance
Special Mob.attack overrides and foreign addon classes
Native player/client motion, damage-stage and render acceptance
sanitization: Only synthetic test numeric/name facts; no machine paths, absolute ticks, entity IDs, worlds, private scripts, raw logs or engine file inventories.
